observations.body: The song joins throne, scepter, equity, love of righteousness, and royal anointing.
observations.label: An everlasting throne and equitable scepter

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside an everlasting throne and equitable scepter.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Psalms 45:4–8 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the song joins throne, scepter, equity, love of righteousness, and royal anointing. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: An everlasting throne and equitable scepter
